requirements.requirement: Provide tidy storage for sewing supplies
requirements.evidence: Build has 3 hex cells: bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full (open tray) + bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full-div2 (2-compartment tray) + bin:1,-1,0~hex-bin-full (open tray) plus cover:1,0,0 work surface. Provides sorted compartments for notions, but configurator has no sewing-specific props (scissors, thread spools, needles, fabric) so staged with generic small tools: tape measure and brush.

finish.summary: Built compact 3-cell L-shaped organizer with one 2-compartment divided bin for small notions and two open bins plus a flat top cover for work. Dressed with available small props; no dedicated sewing props exist in catalog, so function is shown generically.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
